reviews.text: The Dog University is a great place! We can thank Nora a lot. I adopted Kubu when he was 4 months old and unfortunately he already had a lot of trauma. It was not possible to touch or pet him very much. He was afraid of people, especially men, so he barked at them everywhere. He also had to be taught to stay home alone. At first, I couldn't go from one room to another because he completely panicked when he couldn't see me. He wasn't reconciled with cats either, so I had to get him used to my cat. We have come a long way to make Kubu a balanced, happy dog ​​and the Dog University played a big role in this. Thank you! 🙂 We also completed the cooperative care course not only with Kubu, but also with my cat Cili. Our lives have become much easier because of it, both they and I enjoy this great way of caring for animals! 😃

This is the second time I've worked with Nora online: the first time she helped me with my reactive dog, and now we're getting my cat used to an inhaler. She's brilliant in both cases! I really like that she always provides practical advice, she notices little things that I, as a layperson, would absolutely not see. The trainings are held in a great atmosphere and, in addition to being a good program for me, it gives me a completely new perspective on animals. 🩷

Nora's knowledge and commitment are unparalleled. More importantly, she approaches problems with empathy, understanding, and curiosity. She doesn't offer formulaic solutions, but tries to look deep into the behavior and patiently present possible solutions to both the owner and the dog.

We turned to Nora based on a recommendation and we absolutely did not regret it. She completely thought through the situation, health and mental load of our reactive dog. She helped us develop a suitable daily/weekly routine, and also connected me with a veterinarian who could provide medication support in addition to training. She also taught me a lot, which allowed me to develop a more consistent and predictable system for my dog. We owe her a lot of gratitude, because in just a few months she not only made our everyday life much easier, but also made our dogs more prepared for the arrival of our baby.

We have worked and continue to work with Nora a lot, she has helped us through the low points of dog ownership and training. She is professionally high-level, a good observer and listener, and owner-centered, while keeping the dog's well-being in the center. On top of all that, she is also a good person!

We first met Nora at a reactive group session, and since then we have participated in many social walks organized by her. These opportunities are very helpful for our reactive dog, and for me as an owner. She is helpful, has up-to-date …

I can only recommend Nora.

I am incredibly grateful for the help Nora provided. She has helped me understand my dog's behavior and taught me how to react appropriately without any physical punishment. Her approach is modern, kind, and effective. Highly recommend her services!

I have listened to several online lectures by Nora and without exception, each one was characterized by expertise and kindness. Unfortunately, we have not met in person yet, but there is a lot of educational material available on her online platforms. She represents non-violent, modern education and care, I can only recommend her!

Nora was the 3rd trainer we worked with and I wish we had found her sooner. She helped our traumatized, reactive dog with modern and practical ideas to make everyday life easier. I absolutely recommend her, she is the best choice.
